name: Vinculum
brief: Vinculum is a global Omnichannel retailing enabler that help brands and retailers easily scale, reach and delight customers across channels.Vinculum Connector enables streaming relevant Vinculum performance data into a user determined warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
about:
Vinculum's solutions are pre-integrated to work with multiple marketplaces across the different countries in which we operate.  
  
Learn more about [Vinculum API documentation.](https://www.vinculumgroup.com/)
